text:
Jordan: Heads up — vendor split our RMA into 2 AWBs and one tranche is stuck in FRA customs. This would remove ~16 H100s from eu-dedicated pool for next week. Need recon + options.
Maya: which POs/serials? can we reroute?
Jordan: PO: 4521-RED, 4522-RED. Serials: H100-AX1001..AX1016. Tracking: https://track.example/awb/EC123456789DE. Vendor note says 'staggered ship, customs hold on partial'.
Nina (FwdVendor): sorry, FRA hit a paperwork flag. We can either: 1) push full expedite air for the stuck AWB (ETA 48h) at +$2k/unit, or 2) consolidate and re-export (ETA 7-10 days) with no expedite fee.
Eli: If we lose 16 H100s for a week that kills throughput for a handful of dedicated customers. Any chance of temporary loaners from APAC pool?
Jordan: APAC loaners OK but needs cross-region transfer approvals, takes ~24h to schedule. Also provisioning + network peering needs heads-up.
Maya: Can vendor provide photo/manifest evidence for customs to speed clearance? sometimes a docs resubmit clears it same day.
Nina (FwdVendor): yes. I can push a corrected commercial invoice and serial manifest now. I'll also ask FRA broker to escalate.
Jordan: also please confirm if vendor can credit the expedite cost if customs clears within 24h — otherwise we'll be charged. We want contingency finance-approved before spending.
Nina (FwdVendor): I can offer a partial credit: waive expedite fee if we accept the 7-10 day re-export option for the remaining 8 units (i.e., split acceptance). If you want guaranteed 48h airbridge, cost stands.
procure-bot: PO 4521-RED & 4522-RED — approval status: pending finance-confirmation for expedite up to $32,000. Link: https://redwood.internal/po/4521-4522
Eli: threading options: (A) approve expedite for 16 -> risk $32k; (B) accept split: 8 expedited now, 8 re-exported -> avoids fee for second tranche; (C) request APAC loaners + consolidate later. Thoughts?
Maya: prefer B if vendor holds credit promise in writing. ask for a short email from Nina confirming waive terms.
Jordan: +1. Nina, please send written confirmation and attach broker ticket id once submitted. I'll escalate finance if needed.
Nina (FwdVendor): will send email in 10m and push broker ticket now. Broker ticket: BRK-98431.
Jordan: awesome. tagging @finance for visibility. :thumbsup:
Maya: also can ops pre-stage the node configs so we can swap quickly once units arrive? Eli?
Eli: yes — I'll prepare a staging runbook and reserve ip ranges. will ping infra-oncall when we have final ETA.
Jordan: thanks all — I'll update the dedicated pool dashboard and notify 2 impacted customers once we have the vendor email. :pray:
